name: Tsuba Millinery
description: A bold, Japanese-minimal store theme for a small milliner's atelier in Hoshikawa City: cloches, boaters, buckets and wide brims blocked by hand, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Washi pages with a faint fibre texture, large fields of edo-murasaki purple (#745399), ai indigo (#165E83) and matcha (#C5C56A), a shu vermilion (#EB6101) seal and sumi ink; Kaisei Opti for display and vertical titles, M PLUS 2 for text. The header (H11) is a vertical signboard in the top-left corner: a vermilion seal with the wordmark set vertically and the menu as vertical columns read from the right. The home page (L5) is an asymmetric 12-column layout in vertical type: the title stands vertically beside an etching laid over an Edo purple field, Find your shape keeps the filter-first catalogue (shape, material, head size) with the hats in a staggered grid, the four shapes are tall vertical strips on a matcha band with a cut-out hat breaking over its edge, then three steps, fit and sizing on indigo and the journal as a ruled index. The footer (F4) leads with the seasonal letter on an Edo purple band over a deep shikon base with the vertical wordmark. Hand-tinted copperplate etching illustrations. Fit & sizing, Made to order, Atelier, journal, newsletter and contact. The shop card, the sizing guide and the shapes table each live in one synced pattern; material and brim print under every price (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop shows a static catalogue that filters by shape and material without JavaScript, and orders go by email).

deviation: 1.1.0 redesign (issue #67): H12/F3/L14 became H11/F4/L5 (combo unused; neighbours #8 Asagao H5/F10/L12 and #10 Kumotori H7/F12/L10 share no code). Palette: washi #F4EFE3 ground with a procedural fibre texture; edo-murasaki #745399 (opening field, letter band; also links and small labels, 5.3:1 on washi, 4.7:1 on kinari), ai indigo #165E83 (fit band) and matcha #C5C56A (shapes band) as large fields; shu vermilion #EB6101 for the seal, numerals and marks only (2.9:1 on washi, 4.6:1 on the shikon footer); shikon #2B1E3A footer; sumi #1C1C1C text (14.9:1); nezumi #57524A quiet text (6.8:1); gofun #FBF8F1 on purple 5.8:1, on indigo 6.7:1, on shikon 14.7:1; pale fuji #C9B8DD labels on shikon 8.4:1; pale ai #BFD6E2 on indigo 4.7:1; sumi on matcha 9.4:1; ai numerals on matcha 3.9:1 (large only). Fonts: Kaisei Opti and M PLUS 2 (OFL-1.1, no Reserved Font Name), subset to Latin WOFF2, Kaisei with a few kanji used as CSS-escaped decorative marks. Visual style: hand-tinted copperplate etching (indigo and vermilion washes) from Grok Build image_gen, one picture per hat, plus a cut-out hat (transparent WebP) that breaks over the matcha band edge; washi texture drawn procedurally. Image names from 1.0.0 are kept so imported pages keep working. New industry millinery, page tags fit-sizing and made-to-order.
